concepts.title: Multiplication of a Whole Number and a Fraction
concepts.definition: To multiply a fraction and a whole number, we divide the multiplicand by the denominator of the multiplier and then multiply the result by the numerator, or treat the whole number as a fraction with denominator 1.
concepts.key_idea: Repeated addition of the fractional part.

multiply {whole_num} by {num}/{den}

concepts.definition: When multiplying fractionssimply put, , we can first divide the numerator and denominator by their common factors before multiplying.
concepts.key_idea: Reducing fractions to lowest form (apavartana) simplifies calculation.

concepts.title: Magnitude of Product
concepts.definition: The relationship between the product and the numbers multiplied depends on whether they are between 0 and 1 or greater than 1.
concepts.key_idea: Multiplying by a fraction less than 1 decreases the value.
question_patterns: is the product of {val1} and {val2} greater than {val1}

solution_steps.action: Check if factors are between 0 and 1
solution_steps.explain: If both are < 1, product is less than both. If one is > 1 and one is < 1, product is between them.

solution_steps.action: Compute the product of the two factors
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the two numbers to obtain the product for comparison.

solution_steps.action: Compare the product with the original factors
solution_steps.explain: Use the rule: multiplying by a fraction less than 1 decreases the value, while multiplying by a number greater than 1 increases it.

concepts.title: Division of Fractions
concepts.definition: Division of oneput differently,  fraction by another is equivalent to multiplication of the first fraction by the reciprocal of the second.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the dividend by the reciprocal of the divisor.

concepts.key_idea: Triple multiplication of a number by itself; the reverse operation is cube root.
